# Mutabasir — The Director's Lens

> Bilingual (English + Arabic) executive intelligence platform for PMOs,
> contracting authorities and consultancies. Turns project documents
> (contracts, tenders, O&M reports, construction files) into board-grade
> dashboards in about 90 seconds, with every figure cited to its source.

Homepage: https://mutabasir.ae/
Publisher: Beyond Connect General Trading L.L.C (United Arab Emirates)

## What it does

Mutabasir reads uploaded PDF, DOCX and text files, extracts structured
facts using a small on-device AI model (WebLLM · Llama 3.2 1B / Qwen 2.5
0.5B / Phi 3.5 mini) that runs entirely in the user's browser, composes
a bilingual executive brief, and publishes a print-ready dashboard.

Documents never leave the user's device during extraction.

## Product surfaces

- Marketing site: /, /pricing, /faq, /privacy, /terms
- Workspace (auth-gated): /projects, /projects/[id], /projects/[id]/published, /new, /settings
- API: /api/health

## Supported subjects

- Contract management
- Tender evaluation
- Operations and maintenance
- Construction project delivery

## Deliverables per project

- Bilingual A4 executive dashboard (PDF)
- WhatsApp-forwardable 5-line summary (planned)
- Formal Arabic letter, Director-General register (planned)

## Key differentiators

- Every extracted fact is returned with HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW confidence
  and a verbatim source quote.
- Native Gulf-formal Arabic register, not translated English.
- On-device AI: no document upload, no third-party API in the extract
  path.
- 5-point quality gate blocks weak dashboards from being published.
